title: ShieldCare Claim Windows, Proof and Review Days
content:
## Schedule of windows and proof by plan

| Plan | Report window from the incident, days | Proof of purchase needed | Police report needed on a theft claim | Days to supply missing documents | Days a review may run | Days to appeal a denial | Claims worked ahead of the queue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 30 | yes | yes | 14 | 10 | 30 | no |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 30 | yes | yes | 14 | 10 | 30 | no |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 60 | yes | yes | 21 | 7 | 45 | yes |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 45 | yes | yes | 21 | 7 | 45 | yes |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 30 | yes | yes | 14 | 10 | 30 | no |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 90 | no | yes | 30 | 5 | 60 | yes |

Note 1. The report window is counted from the day the failure or damage happened, and it is
the window inside which the customer must report the loss for a claim to be opened on a
Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan.

Note 2. Proof of the original purchase must be on file before a claim is adjudicated on every
plan but ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection, where it is not required. A police report is
required on a theft claim on every plan without exception, including those that do not carry
theft as a peril at all.

Note 3. The days to supply are the days the customer has to produce a missing document
before the claim is denied for want of proof: 14 days on ShieldCare Essential Parts and
Labour, ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus and ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service, 21
on ShieldCare Total Device Protection and ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium, and 30 on
ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.

Note 4. The review days are the days a claim may sit under review before a decision must be
recorded, and run shortest on ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection at 5 days. The appeal
window is the days after a denial within which the customer may appeal, and runs longest on
the same plan at 60 days.

Note 5. Claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue on ShieldCare Total Device Protection,
ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium and ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.
